controller.mapping_summary: Jaguar full-keypad/sticks profile maps the numeric keypad, action buttons and analog controls.

files.description: [BIOS] Atari Jaguar CD (World).j64 (Jaguar CD BIOS, retail - optional override)
[BIOS] Atari Jaguar Developer CD (World).j64 (Jaguar CD BIOS, developer - optional override)

firmware.notes: Jaguar boot ROM and CD BIOS images are embedded; these optional system-directory files override the embedded CD BIOS in real-BIOS CD mode.

saves.naming: The pinned core-info metadata declares libretro_saves=true but does not declare a persistent-save filename extension.
saves.notes: Persistent save support is declared by the pinned core-info metadata; filename and content semantics are not specified there.

states.naming: RetroArch frontend state names are <content-basename>.state and <content-basename>.stateN for slots.
